# Two synthetic course packets

## CS-MINI / C1: supplied loop notes
For positive integers, integer division by 2 keeps the floor of the quotient. In `while (x > 1) { x = x / 2; count++; }`, test the condition before each body execution. Count begins at 0 and increases once per execution. The loop stops when the condition is false. Covered: tracing this loop. Excluded: recursion and complexity analysis. No instructor answer key or scoring rubric provided.

## AST-MINI / A1: supplied astronomy notes
Apparent retrograde motion is westward apparent motion against the background stars. In the supplied heliocentric account of an outer planet, the viewing geometry changes as Earth passes that planet. Apparent retrograde does not mean that the planet reverses its orbital direction. Covered: this qualitative distinction only. Excluded: Doppler formulas and eclipses. No instructor answer key or scoring rubric provided.
